summary: Digital Realty Trust filed an 8-K on October 9, 2026, disclosing that its indirect finance subsidiary, Digital Euro Finco, LLC, issued and sold €1.0 billion aggregate principal amount of 5.125% Guaranteed Notes due 2036. The senior unsecured notes are fully and unconditionally guaranteed by Digital Realty Trust, Inc. and its operating partnership and were sold offshore under Regulation S, unregistered under the Securities Act. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or ownership changes are involved. This is a routine debt-capital-raising event; watch leverage, refinancing spreads, and FX/rate sensitivity rather than any deal arbitrage angle.
